question: How is the brilliant goddess characterized in relation to those who have attained all powers?
premises: Her radiance is likened to a cloud bearing streams of self-willed darkness.
She is associated with those who have reached all attainments.
inference: The brilliant goddess, radiant like a cloud of self-willed darkness, is linked to those who possess all attainments.
plain_english: O brilliant one, whose splendor is like a cloud bearing streams of self-willed darkness, you belong to those who have attained all powers.
